rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people or actions being in agreement or moving together.

example.english: Everyone agreed in unison to start rehearsing next week.
example.traditional: 大家一致同意下星期開始排練。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 jat1 zi3 tung4 ji3 haa6 sing1 kei4 hoi1 ci2 paai4 lin6

rows.note: Use this for musicians or instruments playing the same notes together.

example.english: The orchestra played the final passage in unison, and it sounded powerful.
example.traditional: 管弦樂團最後一段用齊奏，聲勢好震撼。
example.jyutping: gun2 jyun4 ngok6 tyun4 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 dyun6 jung6 cai4 zau3 sing1 sai3 hou2 zan3 ham6

rows.note: Use this technical term for the same-pitch interval itself, rather than for the performance.

example.english: In music theory class, we learned that a unison is an interval between two notes of exactly the same pitch.
example.traditional: 樂理堂講到，同度音程係兩個音高完全相同嘅音程。
example.jyutping: ngok6 lei5 tong4 gong2 dou3 tung4 dou6 jam1 cing4 hai6 loeng5 go3 jam1 gou1 jyun4 cyun4 soeng1 tung4 ge3 jam1 cing4
